silhouette.reason: Reads as a big cat in SIDE and 3/4 (level back, low head, J tail, digitigrade legs), and the haunch is fuller. The ears are still wrong at 3/4: in hero.png and portrait.png the near ear is a flat ring/disc and the far ear a black horn-like spike, and the fur cards make the back outline bristly like quills.
fixes: thicken the ear shell and round its rim in ears.ts so it keeps a rounded outline edge-on (no disc / horn at 3/4)
shorten and lay the back fur cards flatter along the hair flow so the topline stays smooth

proportions.reason: Sourced numbers hold (2.2 × 0.5 × 1.0 m sheet). By eye the trunk is still long and tubular in SIDE and TOP (a waisted tube with no brisket depth), and the head reads small for an Amur male.
fixes: shorten the trunk masses ~5% and deepen the brisket in torso.ts
enlarge the head ~5% and widen the cheek ruff in head.ts

materials.reason: Fur cards and whiskers now break light on the back and ruff, the nose is a pink leather and the eyes amber; but stripes printed on the cards read as black scratch strokes floating off the body, the chin/ruff cards read as grey straw, and the face is smooth matte plastic.
fixes: colour each fur card from the skin under its root only (no stripe stamped across a card) so stripes stay painted on the coat
warmer, softer white on the ruff cards (cream, not grey) with alpha-tapered tips
short fur cards or a shell over the face so it stops reading as plastic

detail.reason: Whiskers, teeth, toe pads, claws, a nose scar and fur locks are present now and hold at the portrait distance; the face planes (brow, cheekbone) are still soft and the ear interior is a flat disc.
fixes: sharper cheekbone and brow planes in face.ts
ear interior hair tufts and the white ocellus spot on the ear back

wear.reason: Paws are darkened with soil and there is a pale scar on the nose bridge; nothing else: no ear notch, no damp lower legs, no matted belly fringe.
fixes: a notch in one ear and two scars on the shoulder
damp, darker, clumped fur on the lower legs and belly fringe

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 (3k tris) keeps the outline but is heavily faceted, the stripes become random dark triangles and the white belly zone breaks into patches, so the switch shifts the pattern.
fixes: paint LOD2 stripes as 6–8 broad authored bands instead of sampling the LOD0 pattern per triangle
build LOD2 legs from the sculpt with a gentle inflate instead of tubes

technical.reason: QA clean; 143k / 29k / 3k triangles over 6 draws, with fur cards and whiskers where they show.
fixes: trim LOD0 fur-card count on the hidden belly and inner legs and spend it on the face
